findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: same_stock, st0x_premium, st0x_pulse, st0x_registry, solana_token_verdict · Private data: same_stock, st0x_pulse, st0x_registry, solana_token_verdict · Public sink: same_stock, st0x_premium, st0x_registry, solana_token_verdict.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: same_stock, st0x_premium, st0x_pulse, st0x_registry, solana_token_verdict · Private data: same_stock, st0x_pulse, st0x_registry, solana_token_verdict · Public sink: same_stock, st0x_premium, st0x_registry, solana_token_verdict

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
